prompt_meta.title: GA Growth Loop: Deep Links + Sharing + Notification Navigation (Web + Mobile) for Games & Invites

owner_actions.when: after STEP-0007 report is shared with ChatGPT
owner_actions.instruction: Approve the public share link format (domain/path) proposed in ops/DEEPLINKS.md. (This is approval only; no execution.)

step_objectives.goal: Enable a smooth GA growth loop: share game/invite links, open them on web/mobile, land on the right screen, and make notifications actionable.
outcomes: Shareable links for game detail and private invite redemption exist (web links + mobile deep links)
Mobile deep link handling routes users correctly (logged out → login → return; onboard gating respected)
Web routes handle shared links and show the right state (login/onboarding required flows)
Invite code sharing is one-tap on mobile and web (native share sheet / web share / copy fallback)
Notifications list items navigate to the relevant game/invite and reflect read/unread correctly
constraints: No external credentials required (no Firebase, no Kakao SDK keys, no Apple/Google console).
No new core product domains (no venues, no chat, no payments).
Must reuse existing invite tokens and notifications; only extend as needed to support routing and share.
definition_of_done: IDE ensures Docker/infra is running as needed (auto-start) and tests run green
API supports generating/formatting share links (or server-side canonical link logic) and mapping notifications → target routes
Web: share controls exist for games/private invites + routes resolve correctly
Mobile: deep links resolve correctly and share sheet works for game + invite
Notifications tap-through works on both Web and Mobile
Docs added: ops/DEEPLINKS.md and ops/SHARING_MODEL.md (and API contracts updated)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: No owner execution; IDE auto-starts what it needs.
requirements: Ensure Docker daemon and infra are running if needed for tests.
Run migrations only if required; keep minimal.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes docker/compose evidence if touched
All tests pass from repo root

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Shared links open the correct page/screen reliably.
requirements: Define canonical web routes for: game detail, invite redemption.
Define mobile deep link scheme/routes for the same targets.
Support login/onboarding gating while preserving return-to destination after auth/onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests verify routing decisions for key states (unauthenticated/onboarding-complete)
Docs clearly explain link formats and routing behavior

deliverables_outcomes.goal: One-tap sharing of game and invite.
requirements: Game detail: share button produces a shareable link.
Private game host: share invite link/code via share controls.
Web fallback: copy-to-clipboard if Web Share API unavailable.

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Notifications are actionable and route users to the right target.
requirements: Notification payload (or mapping) supports navigation targets (e.g., gameId / inviteToken).
Web + Mobile notifications list supports tapping a notification and routing accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover: creating a notification with target and navigating to the target route/screen

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Make future push + Kakao share easy later.
requirements: Create ops/DEEPLINKS.md describing: URL formats, mobile scheme, routing rules, auth/onboarding return-to handling.
Create ops/SHARING_MODEL.md describing: what gets shared (game vs invite), localized message templates, privacy considerations.
acceptance_criteria: Tradeoffs explicitly recorded (e.g., placeholder domain strategy)

tasks.name: Ensure infra running (executor-owned)
tasks.objective: Auto-start Docker/infra if needed; confirm readiness for tests.

tasks.name: Implement deep link routing (Web + Mobile)
tasks.objective: Add canonical routes and mobile deep link handlers with return-to flow.

tasks.name: Add share UX for game + invites (Web + Mobile)
tasks.objective: Share buttons, localized templates, and fallbacks.
acceptance: Share outputs correct links; localized strings used

tasks.name: Make notifications actionable
tasks.objective: Notification targets route user to game/invite and mark read properly.

tasks.name: Docs + manifest + report
tasks.objective: Write docs, update manifest, produce complete report.
acceptance: Docs complete; manifest updated; report complete

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate any execution to the owner. Choose implementation freely. Update ops/manifest.json and write a complete reports/STEP-0007.report.json with no placeholders.
